data.name: Nabab
data.short_meaning: Lord of the night, God of the new moon
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit term ‘Nabhah’ meaning ‘sky’ or ‘heavens’, the name Nabab is a revered title given to the Hindu god of the night, Chandra, or the moon god. Nabab is also known as the god of the new moon and is considered a symbol of creation, regeneration, and new beginnings.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the cycle of creation and destruction, and the infinite potential for renewal and transformation.

data.spiritual_significance: Nabab, as a spiritual manifestation, represents the constant cycle of creation, destruction, and rebirth. It evokes feelings of peace, tranquility, and introspection, inspiring individuals to seek inner wisdom and enlightenment. In Hindu tradition, the moon god is also closely associated with the god of fertility and rejuvenation, further adding to the name’s profound symbolic meaning.
